answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond keyed to its falcon identity before answering, with the bond slashed when juries catch copied or incoherent work. A dune stake makes each fake identity expensive: a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond per sockpuppet and still loses it on detection, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back. Add a jetty delay between bond posting and answer acceptance so rapid mass-created identities cannot flood an epoch before juries can review them.
